_meta.title: Estate Subsystem — Sir Abisec of Stapleford (Knight Banneret of Hindon)
_meta.authoritative: This JSON is the AUTHORITATIVE source for ALL estate numbers — cash, income, expenses, improvements, fortification DV, settlement & military demographics. estate.md is prose companion only; on any numeric conflict, THIS file wins.
_meta.currency: Tracked to GBP 0.1 (decimals of a pound). 1 GBP = 20 shillings (s) = 240 denarii (d). Convert windfalls/wages/ransoms to GBP at the moment of entry.
_meta.reconcile_cadence: Reconciled each WINTER PHASE (Step 4 economic + Step 8 Glory). Mid-year: append an ad-hoc cash.ledger entry for every windfall, grant, wage, plunder, or capital project, keeping the running balance current. The world-tick 'estate & entourage' hook fires this.

rules.customary_revenue: CR per holding = sum of income lines (assized rents + production + court/market + improvement yields). CR = the Honour value (Ruling #26b). Annual Land Glory = CR, capped 100/yr (Ruling #26e). Baron tier = Honour 200-300.
rules.expenses: Itemized CONCRETELY, never a flat 55/25/10/10 (that default over-stated a frugal lord). Categories: Army (the dominant real cost — eschille, garrison, warhorses, arms, castle ward), Court (admin + hospitality), Family (ACTUAL dependents only). Abisec is Temperate 13 / Modest 13 — he lives lean, so expenses run well under the old default and the estate BANKS a surplus.
rules.operating_surplus: operating_surplus = CR - expenses_total. Banked to liquid each Winter Phase reconciliation.
rules.liquid_cash: cash.liquid_gbp is the running balance, to 0.1. EVERY windfall, grant, wage, and capital project is logged in cash.ledger with its delta and the resulting running balance.
rules.improvements: Each improvement: build_cost (one-time, paid from liquid), annual_yield (added to the holding's CR), space (land/sites it occupies), risk (e.g., cattle murrain = an annual roll), status (built/planned).
rules.fortification_DV: Per element, KAP Defence Value. Wet moat adds to the ditch's DV. Updated as works complete; tower cadence = one wooden tower (GBP 15) per season, no debt.
rules.maintenance_glory: Winter Phase Step 8: maintenance Glory = libra ACTUALLY spent on conspicuous display/largesse. Frugal Abisec spends little, so this is LOW (the deliberate trade-off for banking cash). NOT the same as total upkeep.
rules.economic_grade: Set by ESTABLISHMENT (castle + CR + household), NOT by personal splurge. Abisec is Superlative (castle + GBP 67 CR + a banneret's household) and stays so while living frugally — keeping the +2 horse / +3 family Winter-Phase modifiers.

ledger.entry: Opening liquid — Bedegraine ransom reserve 99.0 + purse 9.0
King's grant — half the forger's recovered silver (the thief's purse)
482 operating surplus banked (CR 67.0 - expenses 50.5; frugal living)
Two wooden towers (15.0 ea), flanking the wool-town wall
Breach patch — timber+rubble (storm's own) + free town labor [Mabli Stewardship CRIT]

cash.note_483: Flood fully repaired by spring 483 (~£6 total: £1 patch + £5 spring). Liquid £104.5.

glory.note: 10 Glory short of 3,000 at WP482 -> NO new Bonus Point this year (frugal living kept maintenance Glory low). The 3rd Bonus Point (and Battle 19->20) lands on the FIRST deed of 483 -- a single scene away. Battle currently 19 (Dedicated-Study +1 at WP482).

hindon.name: Hindon — the caput (chief seat)
hindon.tenure: Crown grant (spring 482): Knight Banneret holding the caput FOR the King on the perpetual-fealty vow; his till the line fails, forfeit twice as fast if ever turned. The outliers (~95 GBP, 8 parcels) escheated/withheld by the Crown.

detail.army: 5 household knights (fed/armed/horsed) 12.0 | garrison ~12 spears + sergeants 9.0 | warhorses & remounts 5.0 | arms & armour upkeep/replacement 3.0 | castle ward, watch, repairs 3.0
detail.court: steward (Mabli) + seneschal (Bledig) + reeve/clerks + manor-court & market admin 5.5 | hospitality (frugal day-table + the march-affinity feast) 3.0
detail.family: ward Lady Senara's keep 2.0 | Father Custennin (chaplain) 0.5 | alms/minor dependents 0.5  [NO wife/children -> low]

fortification.type: shell-keep castle joined by drawbridge to a walled, moated wool-town (the 'bolt')

keep_shell.notes: ringed by ditch+rampart DV 3 + wet moat (+4) -> no dry approach

wool_town_wall.notes: enclosed in stone (DV 5) — 483 flood breach REBUILT in stone by spring 483 (DV 5 restored)

town_ditch.notes: wet moat off the dammed mill-stream

towers.notes: flank the town wall -- enfilade the gate & corners, deny escalade; cadence one/season

drawbridge.notes: keep<->town over the moat; raised = each sealed off, no dry approach to either

cistern.notes: deep cistern/vault -- siege water & secure store

fortification.summary: Keep 9 / bailey 13 / gate 4, moated; walled+moated wool-town (wall DV 5, ditch DV 7) with 2 flanking towers; joined by a drawbridge. Stout vs raiders or a rebel; USELESS vs a king's host -- 'loyal initiative, not a power-base' (the pitch that won the King's floor).
fortification.furnishings_note: Magnificent hall -- a ONE-TIME display VALUE, not income, not an annual hospitality tax (Ruling #26f). The treason-silver's legacy.

improvements.name: The bolt (integrated keep+town fortification)
improvements.space: the wool-town perimeter + keep ditch; mill-stream dammed

improvements.name: Vaccary (cattle herd)
improvements.status: built WP 482 | HIT (483 flood: ~12 head drowned; herd reduced, first-year yield ~halved, restock ~£3) | restocked spring 483 (12 head off Cadwal, ~£2); herd back near strength
improvements.space: PASTURE -- shares the chalk-down grazing with the wool-flocks (ample, no conflict)
improvements.risk: murrain: annual d20 at WP -- on 1-2 lose the year's yield, on a 1 lose the herd (rebuild cost)

improvements.name: Mellisarium (apiary)
improvements.space: MINIMAL -- a sheltered forage corner near lime-blossom/heather/wildflower on the down's edge
improvements.risk: low; hard winter can thin the hives
improvements.bonus: wax (candles) + mead -> eases the hall's hospitality without cash

improvements.name: Wooden towers
improvements.effect: + town wall defence at gate & corners

wool_town.name: Hindon town
wool_town.features: market cross; weekly market + an annual fair; the WOOL STAPLE (the economic engine, purged honest 482); guild hall; church & chapel; the lord's mill
wool_town.status: newly WALLED & MOATED (the bolt); 2 flanking towers

settlement.home_manors_vills: ~4 vills + the lord's demesne farms; ~50 tenant holdings (virgates/bovates)
settlement.demesne: lord's home farms -- arable + the downland SHEEP-FLOCKS (the wool) + oxen/dairy; now + the cattle vaccary & the apiary
settlement.lands: chalk downland (sheep & now cattle), arable home-manor fields, river meadow, the mill-stream (dammed for the moats)

military.servitium_debitum: ~5-6 knights + ~16 foot (per Ruling #26c: 1 knight + 2 field + 1 garrison foot per 10 GBP CR). The King MAY reduce by grace given the sworn vow.
military.standing_garrison: the eschille (5-6 household knights) + ~12 spears/sergeants + the watch
military.warhorses: Karu (Charger 6d6), a Courser (6d6), 2 Rouncey (4d6), a Sumpter

key_npcs.name: Mabli
key_npcs.note: see characters.json -- childhood friend, ledgers-genius; runs Hindon's books

key_npcs.name: Sir Bledig
key_npcs.note: see characters.json -- Idnerth's old seneschal, retained; honest, knows every parcel & penny

key_npcs.name: Drustan
key_npcs.personality: Grizzled veteran spearman, blunt and unsmiling; drills the garrison hard and feeds his men first; cares nothing for court, everything for a tight watch. Loyal to a lord who respects the men on the wall.

key_npcs.name: Gwgan the Wool-master
key_npcs.personality: Shrewd, prosperous, calculating -- but honest since Abisec purged the wool-fraud and cut the mill-toll. The staple's voice; wants stability above all (stability is profit). A useful barometer of the town's mood.

key_npcs.name: Rhiwallon
key_npcs.personality: Meticulous, dry, incorruptible -- installed to keep the staple's weights & tolls honest after the factor's fraud. Trusts a ledger over a face.

key_npcs.name: Heilyn the Miller
key_npcs.personality: Competent, prosperous, faintly resented (millers take toll); watched since the mill-toll was cut and the hand-querns outlawed. Keeps his head down and the wheel turning.

key_npcs.name: Einion the Reeve
key_npcs.personality: Solid, honest peasant foreman; knows every furrow, tenant, and feud in the vill. The lord's eyes on the land; speaks plainly when asked and not otherwise.

key_npcs.name: Tudur the Smith
key_npcs.personality: Strong, taciturn, indispensable -- arms, tools, horseshoes. Says little, makes much.

key_npcs.name: Gwrgi
key_npcs.personality: Dour, weather-bitten shepherd-reeve of the high downs; suspicious of town men and new lords alike, but fair with his own.

storm_damage_483.dead: ~4 townsfolk (Tegwen's family) drowned in the lower wool-town
storm_damage_483.wall_breach: town-side moat-bank washed out -> breach in the new wool-town wall. PATCHED early winter 483 with a timber-and-rubble palisade (rough but a wall again; DV ~3-4 at that section until the spring stone rebuild restores DV 5).
storm_damage_483.losses: 3 houses; the staple's lower wool-store ruined; ~12 of the new vaccary cattle drowned in the flooded enclosure
storm_damage_483.repair_detail: Mabli CRIT costing: urgent breach PATCH ~£1 (done, early winter 483; storm's own stone+timber + free town labor) + spring proper work ~£5 (stone wall rebuild ~£3, mill ~£1, cattle restock ~£2). Wool-store: not all lost — Mabli salvages & sells the wet wool cheap (~£3 income dent, not a repair).
storm_damage_483.status_resolved: REPAIRED by spring 483 — wall rebuilt (DV5), mill mended, ~12 cattle restocked off Cadwal; the dead mourned. Total cost ~£6.

stapleford.name: Stapleford — the family manor
stapleford.tenure: Held of COUNT RODERICK; settled on Achil (to hold OF Abisec once belted ~484-486); held in trust meanwhile, Bascar resident & running the hall.

detail.army: 3 foot + arms; Achil squiring (no knight's fee drawn yet) 4.5
detail.family: Bascar & Eluned live off the demesne produce -- modest 1.0

stapleford.surplus_note: held in trust; supports Achil's eventual establishment or banked to Abisec's reserve meanwhile

fortification.type: moated, palisaded, gated manor (not a castle)
fortification.summary: DV ~6 -- a stout manor: hall enclosure +4, wet moat +4 to the ditch, gateworks +1.

improvements.name: Mews (the family hawks)
improvements.note: the hawk-and-icicles dynasty mark -- prestige, not income

settlement.vill: Stapleford -- the Wylye demesne + tenant holdings
settlement.features: the manor hall (moated), the Mews, the coneygarth, the armory; a small chapel (Brother Iuan, resident priest)
settlement.character: the dynasty's known gifts -- HEALING, BOOKS, and BIRDS

military.servitium_debitum: 1 knight + 3 foot (the knight = Achil when belted; Abisec answers meanwhile)

key_npcs.name: Bascar
key_npcs.note: see characters.json -- runs Stapleford for Abisec

key_npcs.name: Eluned
key_npcs.note: see characters.json -- keeper of the old rite, healer

key_npcs.name: Maredudd the Reeve
key_npcs.personality: Long-serving, steady, unhurried; Bascar's right hand and the vill's memory. Has run Stapleford's fields through three harvests of trouble without complaint.

key_npcs.name: Iorwerth
key_npcs.personality: A reformed poacher turned keeper -- knows every run and snare because he set them once. Sly, loyal, good with ferrets and excuses.

key_npcs.name: Gwilym Hafod
key_npcs.personality: Quiet, patient, proud of the birds beyond all reason; speaks more gently to a hawk than to a man. Keeper of the hawk-and-icicles line.

key_npcs.name: Selyf the Armorer
key_npcs.personality: Methodical, exacting, a little vain about his work; the armory is his kingdom and his blades are honest.
